subject: ACME pricing & invoice estimate - follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME pricing & invoice estimate - follow-up

Hi John —

Great to meet with you this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

What we heard:
- Primary use case: conversational assistant + summaries for customer support transcripts (30–90s average session).
- Estimated active users: 8k–12k monthly; peak concurrency TBD from call but rough estimate 120–200 concurrent workers.
- Token profile: average prompt 450 tokens, average response 850 tokens => ~1.3k tokens per request.
- Expected monthly request volume: 1.2M–2.5M requests (=> ~1.6B–3.25B tokens / month).
- Target cost target: finance asked for target ~ $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens (this was high-level; please confirm).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the tighter range for monthly requests (best estimate + pessimistic)?
2) Confirm whether ACME needs PCI/PHI handling for any transcripts (affects routing/private deploy).
3) See attached: ACME_token_usage_estimate.xlsx + redwood_pricing_calc.csv — I attached a quick cost model and an invoice-style estimate (invoice_estimate_v1.pdf) for the higher and lower volume scenarios.
4) If the ballpark looks right, we’ll lock assumptions and send a formal invoice/PO-ready estimate and standard SOW.

Notes on the price calc:
- The CSV assumes: hosted Redwood model variant (r1-ml) at $X per 1M tokens baseline plus optional KV-caching and batching as optimizations.
- Line items break out tokens, throughput SLA (99.9%), and a 10% buffer for peak headroom.

Marissa (pricing lead) will drop a detailed cost breakdown within the hour.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up if you want to walk the spreadsheet together.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_token_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_pricing_calc.csv (csv), invoice_estimate_v1.pdf (PDF estimate)

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@acme.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME pricing & invoice estimate - follow-up

Thanks Sean — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Monthly request range: our current projection (post-Q2 ramp) is 1.6M–2.2M requests. We should plan for 2.2M as the baseline for budgeting.
2) Token profile: your per-request tokens look right; we typically see 1.1k–1.5k tokens. Use 1.3k as the median.
3) Budget: finance indicated a target of ~$1,000 per 1M tokens (target rate), but they can flex to $1,300 for first 3 months if performance is proven.
4) No PCI/PHI in transcripts. Some PII redaction downstream but not regulated PHI.

Can you send an invoice-ready estimate for the 2.2M request scenario (approx 2.86B tokens/month at 1.3k tokens/request) and include payment terms and PO details? We'd like a PDF to route to procurement.

Thanks — John
John Doe
Head of Product, ACME.ai

On Fri, May 14, 2027 at 10:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great to meet with you this morning...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ACME pricing & invoice estimate - follow-up

John / Sean —

Attaching a slightly expanded cost breakdown and assumptions (attached as redwood_pricing_calc.csv and invoice_estimate_v1.pdf). Key assumptions for the 2.2M-request scenario (2.86B tokens/month):

Assumptions / unit economics (summary):
- Median tokens/request: 1,300
- Monthly requests: 2.2M => monthly tokens: 2,860,000,000 (~2.86B)
- Target unit price (your ask): $1,000 per 1M tokens => baseline monthly cost = $2,860 * $1,000 = $2,860,000 (note: math shown below uses per-1M buckets)
- Recommended pricing model: blended tiered unit pricing with committed volume discount (first 1B at $1,100 /1M, next 1.5B at $975 /1M, incremental at $900 /1M) yields estimated monthly = $2,667,500 (illustrative)
- Additional line items: data egress (estimated $8k), enterprise support & observability (flat $10k/mo), optional dedicated capacity surcharge (if requested) $20k–$60k/mo depending on GPU profile.
- One-time onboarding & evaluation credits: $25k (recommended).

Quick cost table (text):
- Scenario A (no commit, list rates): 2.86B tokens => 2,860 * $1,100 = $3,146,000
- Scenario B (committed blended tiers): estimated $2,667,500
- Scenario C (aggressive quantization + caching): estimated $2,100,000

Notes: the attached CSV includes a tab showing token bucket math, assumed SDK / request overhead, and a line-level invoice like you requested. I left the payment terms as Net30 by default but can change to Net45 for procurement if needed.

Next steps: 
- Sean: please confirm whether ACME prefers committed blended tiers vs list. 
- John: confirm PO contact and preferred payment terms (Net30 / Net45).
- I can convert the attached estimate into an official PO-ready invoice PDF and signable SOW once terms are confirmed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Pricing Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_pricing_calc.csv (detailed calc), invoice_estimate_v1.pdf (PO-style estimate)
